title: Print one overlay patch
setup: python3 -c 'import json, os, sys; home = os.environ["HOME"]; data = json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); data["target"]["agentDir"] = home + "/.pi/profiles/main-trial"; data["ownerPackages"] = [home + "/git/owner-skills"]; json.dump(data, open(sys.argv[2], "w"), indent=2)' "$HOME/.config/tenant-pi/overlay.json" "$HOME/.config/tenant-pi/overlay-trial.json"
